#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

const int INF = INT_MAX / 100;

struct Edge {
    int to, flow, rev, cost;
    Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d) : to(a), flow(b), cost(c), rev(d) {}
};

class MCMF {
public:
    int N, S, T, maxFlow, minCost;
    vector<vector<Edge>> g;
    vector<vector<Edge>> mat;
    vector<int> pot;
    vector<int> q, vis, prev, preve, dist;

    MCMF(int n, int s, int t) : N(n), S(s), T(t), maxFlow(0), minCost(0) {
        g.resize(N);
        pot.resize(N, 0);
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
        int lu = g[u].size(), lv = g[v].size();
        g[u].push_back(Edge(v, flow, cost, lv));
        g[v].push_back(Edge(u, 0, -cost, lu));
    }

    void toArray() {
        mat.resize(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            mat[i] = g[i];
            g[i].clear();
        }
    }

    bool simple() {
        q.assign(N, 0);
        vis.assign(N, 0);
        prev.assign(N, 0);
        preve.assign(N, 0);
        dist.assign(N, INF);
        q[0] = S;
        dist[S] = 0;
        int front = 1, back = 0;
        while (front != back) {
            int u = q[back++];
            if (back == N) back = 0;
            vis[u] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < mat[u].size(); ++i) {
                Edge &e = mat[u][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int nd = dist[u] + e.cost;
                if (nd < dist[e.to]) {
                    if (vis[e.to] == 0) {
                        q[front] = e.to;
                        if (++front == N) front = 0;
                    } else if (vis[e.to] == 2) {
                        if (--back == -1) back += N;
                        q[back] = e.to;
                    }
                    vis[e.to] = 1;
                    preve[e.to] = i;
                    prev[e.to] = u;
                    dist[e.to] = nd;
                }
            }
        }
        return vis[T] != 0;
    }

    int augment() {
        int p = T, minFlow = INF;
        while (p != S) {
            int pp = prev[p], pe = preve[p];
            minFlow = min(minFlow, mat[pp][pe].flow);
            p = pp;
        }
        p = T;
        while (p != S) {
            int pp = prev[p], pe = preve[p];
            mat[pp][pe].flow -= minFlow;
            mat[p][mat[pp][pe].rev].flow += minFlow;
            p = pp;
        }
        maxFlow += minFlow;
        return minFlow;
    }

    bool calSimple() {
        while (simple()) {
            minCost += dist[T] * augment();
        }
        return true;
    }
};

class InputReader {
public:
    istringstream iss;
    string line;

    InputReader() {}

    string next() {
        while (iss.eof() || iss.fail()) {
            if (!getline(cin, line)) return "";
            iss.clear();
            iss.str(line);
        }
        string token;
        iss >> token;
        return token;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        string s = next();
        return stoi(s);
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        string s = next();
        return stoll(s);
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        string s = next();
        return stod(s);
    }
};

class Solver {
public:
    int n, m, k, c, d;
    vector<int> a, f;

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader &in) {
        n = in.nextInt();
        m = in.nextInt();
        k = in.nextInt();
        c = in.nextInt();
        d = in.nextInt();
        int maxl = n + k;
        int T = n * maxl + 1;
        MCMF ans = MCMF(T + 1, 0, T);
        a.resize(k + 1);
        f.resize(n + 1, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
            a[i] = in.nextInt();
            f[a[i]]++;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            if (f[i] == 0) continue;
            ans.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; ++l) {
                ans.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            int a = in.nextInt(), b = in.nextInt();
            for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; ++l) {
                for (int p = 1; p <= k; ++p) {
                    if (a != 1)
                        ans.addEdge(l * n + a, (l + 1) * n + b, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                    if (b != 1)
                        ans.addEdge(l * n + b, (l + 1) * n + a, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int l = 1; l < maxl; ++l) {
            ans.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
        }
        ans.toArray();
        ans.calSimple();
        if (ans.maxFlow != k) {
            cout << "BUG" << endl;
        } else {
            cout << (int)ans.minCost << endl;
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader ir;
    Solver sv;
    sv.solve(1, ir);
    return 0;
}
